items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: And we had a regular six-piece jazz band. And at that time, it was the Charleston craze was out. And we had Dancing Pete and his dancing partner. We took them over with us.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. So, you recall what the personnel of that band was.

Well, I had a little dad on the banjo. A little bit of a short, comical fellow. And we had a regular six-piece jazz band. And at that time, it was the Charleston craze was out. And we had Dancing Pete and his dancing partner. We took them over with us. And the people went wild over the band. Charleston. And we played for the carnival. And we made some nice money on that trip. And it was treated like kings. And I think it's the Spanish Opera. They had their big opera and everything. And we were supposed to come on…
Did any of the Spanish musicians ever play with you?
